description.narrative: this indicator should be measuring the granted CSOs out of the total which managed to build long term formal partnerships with the MoSD in order to continue the social protection operations in the country

comment.narrative: Information was provided by 73 out of 131 CSOs. Out of the 73 only 6 met both the criterion of funding from MoSD and having established sustainable partnerships accounting for 8 of CSOs. It is clear that the composite indicator represents a very restrictive overall criterion. In contrast about 29 of CSOs indicated to have established sustainable partnerships subindicator 1 and 16 received funding from MoSD subindicator 2
